description: This file defines an interface 'JsonException' for handling JSON-related exceptions in the project, providing methods for error code, description, and reference link.

classes.name: JsonException
classes.description: Interface defining common methods for JSON exceptions, including error code, optional description, and optional hyperlink.

methods.name: getErrorCode
methods.description: Returns a string representing a unique error code for the exception.

methods.name: getDescription
methods.description: Returns an optional description string for the exception.

methods.name: getHref
methods.description: Returns an optional URI linking to further information about the exception.
